title: scutellaria rubicunda subsp. subvelutina
intro: Scutellaria rubicunda subsp. subvelutina, commonly known as Chinese Skullcap, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae) known for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Chinese Skullcap include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and other health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Chinese Skullcap include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of Chinese Skullcap include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
